entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Alex, how can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes and some tires I recently bought.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number please?
Thanks! Okay, I see the order here. A pair of VeloSpeed Carbon shoes and two VeloGrip 25mm tires. What's the reason for the return?
Well, the shoes just didn't fit right, and I decided to go with a wider tire. I only tried them on once, indoors.
Okay, I understand. Just to confirm, are the shoes in their original condition? Have they been used or had cleats installed?
I did **mount** cleats to the shoes, but I only **tested for two seconds** on my trainer. As for the tires, I did **install** them on my wheels to see how they looked.

I see. Unfortunately, because the cleats were **installed** there are visible **cleat marks** on the soles. Also, it looks like the **tires** have **dirty tires** from being mounted. Because of this, and because you **mounted** the cleats and the tires, we **cannot resell** them as new. Our return policy only covers items that are in resalable condition.
Oh, I understand. I didn't realize that would be an issue since I barely used them. Is there nothing you can do?

I completely understand your frustration. While a full return isn't possible, perhaps we can offer you a discount on a future purchase? Maybe a percentage off a new pair of shoes or tires that better suit your needs? Or even a discount on a professional bike fitting with one of our experts?
That would be great! A discount on a fitting sounds perfect!

Excellent! I can offer you a 20% discount code for a bike fitting. The code is FITTING20 and you can use it online or over the phone. This way you can ensure the perfect fit before making another purchase!
Wow, thank you so much, Alex! That really helps. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks again for your help!
Have a great day, and thanks for choosing VeloFit!
